links.outcome: Data extraction accuracy of ChatGLM and LLaMA versus manual input on free-text forms
links.effect: Initial manual input accuracy for free-text forms was 99.59%, ChatGLM extraction accuracy 77.13%, and LLaMA 43.86%.
links.quote: The initial manual input accuracy for free-text forms was 99.59%, the ChatGLM data extraction accuracy was 77.13%, and the LLaMA data extraction accuracy was 43.86%.

unlisted_practices: Electronic source data repository (ESDR) system integrating LLM with eCRFs and EHRs for real-world data extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, extraction accuracy, and efficiency of implementing an LLM-integrated system (ChatGLM) for real-world clinical research data extraction from EHRs compared to manual entry, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
